messages:
harper: Quick update for everyone: we've released a targeted hotfix for Private/on-prem installs (v2.3.1-hotfix1) addressing an audit-log rotation interaction with customer-managed KMS/HSM setups. Short summary and next steps below.

julia: Thanks — can you summarise the impact?

harper: Root cause: when a long-lived streaming session generated high-frequency audit entries, the local log rotator could exhaust its configured slots and temporarily reject writes. That caused telemetry agent backpressure and intermittent healthcheck failures in the control plane. No auth bypass or data exposure observed.

omar: Classification from Security: availability issue only. We'll include an explicit non-breach statement in customer comms. security-bot, confirm scan?

security-bot: security:assessment complete. Type: availability. No evidence of unauthorized access. Risk level: LOW.

julia: Ops — are we rolling this out automatically or requiring customer approval?

ops-bot: rollout:canary started -> private-staging-3. Estimated 10m. Canary monitoring hooks: smoke, audit-write-check, kms-connectivity.

ops-bot: rollout:canary finished. Result: PASS. 4/4 checks green.

harper: Action items: 1) Publish advisory on status with non-breach language and remediation steps. 2) Backport to v2.2 branch for customers on maintenance track. 3) Ops to schedule assisted upgrades for flagged customers (we have 7 with HSM + air-gapped). 4) KB: add validation script and rollback steps.

omar: Customer-facing note draft: "Redwood Private/on-prem: audit log rotation fix (v2.3.1-hotfix1). Impact: in rare HSM/KMS configurations, audit logs may have been rejected temporarily leading to missing entries. No data exfiltration. Remediation: upgrade to v2.3.1-hotfix1 or apply rotation threshold patch. Contact Redwood Support for assisted upgrades."

julia: Please add an ISO/SOC-friendly bullet clarifying there were no integrity or confidentiality violations.

support-bot: queued support outbound messages to the 7 affected accounts. Template link: https://internal.redwood/kb/onprem/audit-rotation-advisory.

harper: Upgrade artifacts: packages.redwood/private/private-installer:v2.3.1-hotfix1 and runtime:v1.14.2-hf1. Images uploaded in 15m. Ops, please monitor the first 3 customer upgrades tomorrow and report any anomalies here.

ops-bot: packages:publish private-installer:v2.3.1-hotfix1 -> packages.redwood/private 1769824602

omar: Compliance/Legal note: proactively notify customers who have opted into central audit shipping or who have contractually required retention for audit logs. I'll coordinate the customer letter.

julia: KB validation snippet for support engineers (to run on control-plane node):
```
# validate audit writer and kms
sudo /opt/redwood/bin/rwctl check-audit --rotate-check --kms-verify
```
Please attach output to support tickets.

harper: Thanks team. We aim to close the advisory after 72 hours with zero regressions. If anyone sees unexpected post-upgrade health signals, ping #eng-oncall and drop results here. :thumbsup:

omar: Noted. I'll prepare the post-release note for the exec update deck.

support-bot: follow-up: scheduled assisted upgrades for 3 customers on 2026-04-02 and 4 on 2026-04-03.

harper: Closing checklist: advisory published, packages pushed, v2.2 backport PR open, canary passed. Good work.
